components.description: Install and verify pinned HOI4 Agent Tools in current-user storage on Windows or native Linux.

required_tools.version: Native x64 Node.js 22.19+ in major 22 or major 24; private npm 11.19.0 on Windows and npm 10.9.9 on Linux

conflicts: existing HOI4 Agent Tools bootstrap

parameters.network_access: Downloads the SHA-512-pinned private npm 11.19.0 (Windows) or npm 10.9.9 (Linux) archive, then the exact hoi4-agent-tools@4.8.0 package from https://registry.npmjs.org. Requires native x64 Node.js 22.19+ in major 22 or major 24; Windows may install current-user Node.js LTS when missing.
expected_writes: Current-user winget-managed Node.js LTS distribution, including bundled npm, when a compatible runtime is missing on Windows
Fresh system-temporary hoi4-setup-npm-* directory for verified npm files, isolated config and cache; removed on ordinary completion
parameters.rollback_boundary: Managed project files roll back transactionally. Node.js and the user-scoped hoi4-agent-tools package are external tool state; replaced package versions are not restored automatically. Private npm never replaces the ambient npm executable or config. Installing a missing compatible Node.js distribution also installs its bundled npm. Temporary private npm files are cleaned on ordinary completion and never reused after interruption.

providers.description: Use the hoi4-imagegen MCP server: one grouped tool per asset group, each with a required family, and a ChatGPT login or your own API key.
requirements: HOI4 Mod Setup installs the hoi4-imagegen binary and the project MCP entry.
A ChatGPT login (`hoi4-imagegen login`) or an API key in the environment (OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, FAL_KEY) or a ComfyUI endpoint.
good_for: Style references from the mod first, vanilla second
Plans with a cost estimate before any paid call
providers.cost_summary: ChatGPT login: plan usage limits apply. API keys: pay per image, shown in the plan before generation.
models: ChatGPT image generation (gpt-6-luna at high effort)

reference_images.notes: Add references with hoi4.image_references (role and rights note). Style references come from the mod's own art first and from the kit's vanilla shelf second.

transparent_background.notes: The tool proves transparency from the saved pixels and refuses an opaque result for a transparent family.

size_limits.notes: This route uses the model's default image size; limits can vary by model.

capabilities.alpha_verification: Open the saved PNG and check its alpha channel before treating it as transparent.
capabilities.fallback_if_no_alpha: Use a selected background-removal route and verify alpha; if none is configured, ask the maintainer for another route.
capabilities.fallback_if_no_edits: Use hoi4.image_edit with a precise instruction, then process, validate and review again.

reference_mcp.name: hoi4-imagegen
reference_mcp.authentication: ChatGPT login or API keys read from the environment
reference_mcp.notes: Release binary installed by HOI4 Mod Setup; the archives, sizes and hashes are declared in the provider route.

providers.description: Use OpenAI image models with a key saved on this computer.
requirements: An OpenAI API key saved in the operating-system credential store.
providers.cost_summary: Pay per image; price changes with model and quality.

reference_images.notes: Reference count depends on model and endpoint. Use local image paths with the edit tool.

transparent_background.notes: Supported GPT Image models can request transparent output. Verify the saved alpha.

size_limits.notes: Use dimensions supported by the selected model.

capabilities.alpha_verification: Open the saved PNG and check its alpha channel before treating it as transparent.
capabilities.fallback_if_no_alpha: Use a selected background-removal route and verify alpha; if none is configured, ask the maintainer for another route.
capabilities.fallback_if_no_edits: Make a new image from the reference if that fits, or choose another configured provider for an edit.

providers.description: Use Google image models through the Gemini API.

size_limits.notes: This route uses the model's default image size; limits can vary by model.

capabilities.alpha_verification: Open the saved PNG and check its alpha channel before treating it as transparent.
capabilities.fallback_if_no_alpha: Use a selected background-removal route and verify alpha; if none is configured, ask the maintainer for another route.
capabilities.fallback_if_no_edits: Make a new image from the reference if that fits, or choose another configured provider for an edit.
